messages:
maria: opening a GCP support ticket — need a burst of A100 v4 capacity in europe-west4 across our two prod projects. target +40 GPUs total (production rollout next week). can cloud-ops own the support coordination? :pray:
ben: on it. can you confirm project ids and billing account so i can attach them to the case?
maria: projects: redwood-prod-01, redwood-prod-02. billing account BA-8492-REDWOOD. usage estimate ~32k GPU hours/month. justification: low-latency EU inference rollout, sustained pool requested.
priya: FYI also ran into inter-zone forwarding rule quota last month — flag any VPC/network quotas in the payload so GCP checks those too.
joon: cost heads-up: if we run all ondemand A100v4 it's ~€120k/month. strongly consider mixed pool (reserved + preemptible) as fallback. cc @alice for finance signoff.
alice: agree. finance wants a short contingency number. maria can you paste the support body you plan to submit so we can reuse it for other regions?
maria: pasting below the support request we sent:
```
Request: Increase GPU quota (A100 v4)
Projects: redwood-prod-01, redwood-prod-02
Region: europe-west4
Resource: acceleratorCount (NVIDIA A100 v4)
Current quota: 8 per project
Requested quota: 48 per project (requested +40)
Justification: Production inference rollout for EU customers; sustained usage expected; billing verification attached.
Attachments: billing_statement_Q4.pdf, company_registration.pdf
```
cloud-ops-bot: created support case CAS-202603-987654 (https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654). assigned to compute quota team.
ben: i attached an anticipated-monthly-hours CSV and a note suggesting fallback regions.
gcp-support: Hi Redwood — Case CAS-202603-987654 received. Please attach billing IAM admin and a recent invoice. Also confirm whether you can accept quota spread across multiple zones in europe-west4. ETA for first review: 48 hours.
maria: uploaded invoice and granted ben billing IAM for case. replied that zonal allocation is acceptable and requested expedited review due to live cutover.
joon: mitigation plan if full quota delayed >48h: spin up smaller burst in europe-west1 (8 A100v4) and route ~10-20% traffic via model routing; buys time for quota.
priya: finance contingency needed for that cross-region plan. @alice can you pre-approve up to €8k emergency spend?
alice: finance tentatively approved €8k contingency pending final cost sheet. please minimize use.
ben: update from GCP — case assigned to regional ops and flagged URGENT. rep Leo (leo@gcp-support.example) requested an urgent contact number. ETA now 24h.
maria: added Leo contact and provided on-call number. asked GCP for a temporary per-project bump while they validate regional capacity.
gcp-support: Applied temporary bump of +8 GPUs per project (now 16). Performing regional capacity check for full allocation. Confirm you can provision small instances so we can validate.
joon: confirmed test provisioning of 2 A100v4 per project succeeded. monitoring alerts green.
priya: action items:
- ben/cloud-ops: follow up with Leo if no update in 12h
- alice/finance: finalize contingency approval and sign cost note
- infra (joon): prepare deployment plan for partial capacity and routing rules
- maria: update the EU region runbook and include network quota checks
maria: will update runbook and post back here when case closes. marking this thread as main coordination channel. :white_check_mark:
